context_semantics.budget: rendered prompt INCLUDING BOS, role markers, generation prefix and any schema text <=8192; generated tokens <=4096; total <=12288. EOS/template overhead must be counted, not appended beyond this budget.
context_semantics.llama_cpp: --ctx-size=12288 is KV/text context allocation, not prompt limit plus output; --n-predict=4096 caps newly generated tokens. With parallel=1 require n_ctx_seq/n_ctx_slot=12288 in logs/props.
context_semantics.ollama: num_ctx=12288 is per-sequence context window; num_predict=4096 or OpenAI max_tokens=4096 caps generated tokens within it. Native options can set num_ctx; OpenAI endpoint needs the pinned model PARAMETER because API does not expose context sizing.

deterministic_padding.construction: At later preflight, count the exact rendered prompt using the runtime tokenizer. Start k=1024 copies of the padding block and target 8064 tokens. If rendered count n is outside 8000..8128, update k=max(0, floor(k*(8064-base_tokens)/max(1,n-base_tokens))); if unchanged, move k by +1 when short or -1 when long. Repeat at most 16 tokenization-only iterations. Freeze the first prompt in 8000..8128, leaving at least 64 extra tokens beyond the 4096 completion reservation within n_ctx. Save rendered bytes, token IDs/count and hashes before inference. If no admissible prompt is found, report preparation unresolved; no semantic selection or model inference is involved.
deterministic_padding.content: Only repetition of this fixed punctuation/digit block; no scholarly text, arithmetic task, retrieval, reasoning, echo correctness or position-recall question.
deterministic_padding.runtime_tokenizer: llama.cpp /apply-template and /tokenize with exact GGUF; Ollama lacks portable tokenizer API, so inspect exact imported template and use same pinned GGUF tokenizer plus first-call prompt_eval_count/log evidence to verify actual prompt length. Stop on mismatch or truncation; do not equate standalone-tokenizer count to runtime count without check.
deterministic_padding.what_it_proves: Allocation/per-sequence context and a long neutral prefill plus short complete structured response; NOT semantic recall or successful generation of a full 4096-token answer.

measurement_protocol.binary_freeze_gate: Before any model load, record exact llama.cpp binary SHA256/bundle manifest and exact Ollama version/executable SHA256. Source tag is not binary identity. If actual Ollama cannot meet documented minimum or lacks specified fields, stop that route pending a separately authorized runtime choice; never silently install or switch versions.
measurement_protocol.cleanup: Stop/unload only audit-owned resources; keep pinned weights and receipts in that future private directory unless explicitly instructed to delete. Restore no unrelated state because none should have changed.
measurement_protocol.hardware_matrix: Later initial mechanical pass: JUNO, all 12 models, one at a time. Apple 16/24/32 and accessibility configurations are separately specified for later hardware validation; availability is not assumed and JUNO cannot stand in for them.
measurement_protocol.isolation: Preflight acquisition/inference needs its own later authorization. Use private paths, loopback, one isolated server, no cloud requests, no existing Ollama tag replacement, no managed target.json changes, no repo writes. If existing host state prevents isolation, stop that hardware cell.
measurement_protocol.limits: 600-second inference watchdog; no invented L_screen/B_worker budget. No semantic pass/fail. OOM or timed-out tuple is recorded without resubmission; scheduled different configurations remain distinct.
measurement_protocol.memory: Sample process-tree RSS and platform resident/physical footprint plus NVIDIA device/process VRAM every 100 ms from load through unload; capture runtime weight/KV/compute allocation logs, actual layer offload, and free/available RAM. Record load peak and inference peak separately. On macOS use physical footprint/Metal allocations and memory pressure; do not sum overlapping unified-memory metrics.
measurement_protocol.sequence: One model and one configuration at a time. Snapshot OS/CPU/RAM/GPU/driver/backend/binary hashes, six threads, batch 512, microbatch 512 where exposed, available RAM/VRAM, baseline process memory and background-load limitations. Load, compact first call, same-process warm call, padded call, unload. No semantic fixtures.
measurement_protocol.timing: Record process-start-to-ready separately from first request and warm request. Cold means process/model cold, not forcibly cleared OS file cache. Measure client wall time, load/prompt/decode timings where supplied; cache reuse must be explicit. Ollama automatic prompt caching may be unavoidable: report cached warm result, do not label it uncached or compare directly to llama.cpp uncached.
